projection: SARDUCAA_MAP.world applied directly: lng = 0.213641 * worldX + 1783.4447, lat = 1709.1136 - 0.213641 * worldY. Identical to the realistic raster, so the two are the same map.
note: Hand-drawn rendering, same frame and affine as assets/tiles. Leaflet CRS.Simple, tile y NEGATIVE upwards. Every tile is opaque: this map draws its own sea, so unlike the realistic pyramid a missing file is a FAULT, not a transparent hole.
